cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Admit What You Wanted
cards.instruction: Maneuver them into revealing which outcome they truly wanted before you explain your own stake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I put my hand up with yours. Before the result comes in, who did you want to win?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We volunteered to count votes. That wasn't a vote for either candidate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Counting preferences. Let's start with yours.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Maya. Weren't you the one who nominated Ruth?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I was. Now tell me what you liked about Maya before you start apologizing for choosing her.

reason: Replace the unsupported confidence overlay with a concrete misunderstood copied action that directs the same-holder Drive pursuit, with a responsive partner and an ending using B4.
